## Endpoints

### Data Read (7)
- `GET /_chat/{_chatId}` — Retrieve chat messages.
- `GET /_zcl/zcal/{zcalId}` — Retrieve calendar event details.
- `GET /biz/getHamburgerMenu.do` — Get the account's hamburger menu.
- `GET /zm/{zmId}` — Retrieve account details.
- `GET /zm/zc/api/v1/accounts` — Retrieve account information.
- `GET /zm/zc/new/jsp/loaded.jsp` — Check if account resources are loaded.
- `POST /zmc/getContactsAlias.do` — Find contact aliases.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /zm/{zmId}` — Update account information.

### Media (1)
- `GET /zmail-public/static/transient/{transientId}` — Get temporary media files.

### Config (3)
- `GET /calendar/external-libs/ext-libs-map.json` — Get calendar library configurations.
- `GET /zm/edisc/api/user/ediscovery/client/config` — Get eDiscovery client configuration.
- `GET /zm/zc/api/v1/accounts/org/preferences` — Get organization preferences.

### Core API (2)
- `GET /integPlatform/integAction.do` — Trigger an integration action.
- `POST /biz/bizApi.do` — Access core account functions.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Accounts Zoho's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Accounts Zoho data without official API access
- Automate actions on accounts.zoho.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Accounts Zoho frontend uses
